text.tspan: Ah! look at all the lonely people.
Ah! look at all the lonely people.
Picks up the rice in a church where a wedding has been Lives in a dream
Wearing the face that she keeps in a jar by the door Who is it for?
All the lonely people Where do they all come from?
All the lonely people Where do they all be
Writing the words of a sermon that no one will hear No one comes near
Darning his socks in the night when there's nobody there
Died in the church and was buried a
long with her name Nobody came
Wiping the dirt from his hands as he walks from the grave
All the lonely people Where do they all come from?
(Ah, look at all the lonely people)
All the lonely people Where do they all be
(Ah, look at all the lonely people)
All the lonely people Where do they all come from?
All the lonely people Where do they all be
